# Once Upon a Katamari

## Where is the options page?

The [player options page for this game](../player-options) contains all the options you need to configure and export a
config file.

## What items get shuffled?
The following items are shuffled into the item pool:
- Level Unlocks
- Cousins
- Presents
- Planets
- Freebies (Rocket, Magnet, Timer, Sonar, Mushroom & Ice Axe)
- Traps (Washpan, Spider & Fog Traps)
- Stardust (filler)

## What locations get shuffled?
The following locations can be checks:
- Level Clears
- Cousins
- Presents
- Crowns
- Meteors (Shooting Stars)
- Collectionsanity: (Almost) every unique object in the game

## What is the goal of this game?
You must collect a number of Planets to unlock the final stage "That Hole...". Complete that stage to goal the game.

## What changes are made from vanilla?
In vanilla, only one cousin appears in a stage at a time, and you must play through a stage multiple times in order
to collect all cousins. In Archipelago, all cousins are immediately available on the first playthrough of a stage.

tutorials.text:
# Once Upon a Katamari Multiworld Setup Guide

## Quick Links
- [Once Upon a Katamari (Steam)](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880620/Once_Upon_A_KATAMARI/)
- [Archipelago Mod (Once Upon An Archipelago)](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/releases)
- [BepInEx 6 build #783](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/783/BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64-6.0.0-be.783%2Bc58c42d.zip)

## Setup
1. Download the Bleeding Edge build #783 of [BepInEx 6](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/783/BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64-6.0.0-be.783%2Bc58c42d.zip).
2. Extract the contents into the game's root folder. By default, this is `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\OnceUponaKATAMARI`.
3. Download the Once Upon an Archipelago plugin from [releases](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/releases), and extract its contents into `BepInEx/plugins`.
4. For **Unix** (Linux, Mac, SteamOS) users only: add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp.dll=n,b" %command%`
to the launch options on Steam, under properties.
5. Start Once Upon a Katamari to generate the necessary configuration files, and then close the game.

## Joining a Multiworld
1. Open `BepInEx/config/OnceUponAnArchipelago.cfg`, and enter the correct server address, slot name and, if applicable,
password.
2. Make sure the Archipelago server is running before launching the game. 
3. Launch Once Upon a Katamari.
4. The game will automatically connect on startup. If successful, you will see a message saying "Archipelago: Connected"
at the bottom of the screen.
5. If you see a red "Archipelago: Not Connected" in the top left corner: close the game, 
check your settings and that the server is running, and relaunch the game.
There is currently no way to reconnect whilst the game is running.
6. Start a brand new save file.

readme.text:
# Once Upon an Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) randomizer for Once Upon a KATAMARI.

## Randomization
The goal is to collect a certain number of Planets to unlock the final level "That Hole...". Plug the hole in the Cosmos Scroll to then goal the game.
Depending on your settings, planets are obtained by clearing levels, players finding them in the multiworld, or both.  
  
The following items are shuffled into the item pool:
- Level Unlocks
- Cousins
- Presents
- Planets
- Freebies (Rocket, Magnet, Timer, Sonar, Mushroom & Ice Axe)
- Traps (Washpan, Spider & Fog Traps)
- Stardust (filler)

The following locations can be checks:
- Level Clears
- Cousins
- Presents
- Crowns
- Meteors (Shooting Stars)
- Collectionsanity: (Almost) every unique object in the game

## Mod Installation
1. Download the Bleeding Edge build #783 of [BepInEx 6](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/783/BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64-6.0.0-be.783%2Bc58c42d.zip).
2. Extract the contents into the game's root folder. By default, this is `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\OnceUponaKATAMARI`.
3. Download the Once Upon an Archipelago plugin from [releases](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/releases), and extract its contents into `BepInEx/plugins`.
4. For **Unix** (Linux, Mac, SteamOS) users only: add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp.dll=n,b" %command%`
to the launch options on Steam, under properties.
5. Start Once Upon a Katamari to generate the necessary configuration files, and then close the game.

## Joining a Multiworld
1. Open `BepInEx/config/OnceUponAnArchipelago.cfg`, and enter the correct server address, slot name and, if applicable,
password.
2. Make sure the Archipelago server is running before launching the game. 
3. Launch Once Upon a Katamari.
4. The game will automatically connect on startup. If successful, you will see a message saying "Archipelago: Connected"
at the bottom of the screen.
5. If you see a red "Archipelago: Not Connected" in the top left corner: close the game, 
check your settings and that the server is running, and relaunch the game.
There is currently no way to reconnect whilst the game is running.
6. Start a brand new save file.

## Additional Info
- The apworld can be found in [releases](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/releases).
- The source code for the apworld can be found [here](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Archipelago-OUAKatamari/tree/ouakatamari/worlds/ouakatamari).
- In vanilla, only one cousin appears at a time in a stage, requiring the player to play through the stage multiple times.
In Archipelago, all cousins will appear in the same playthrough.
- The music player and every song is available from the start.
- The Mushroom freebie increases your katamari's size by 10% normally, or 20% for its super variant.
The Ice Axe freebie allows you to scale walls much higher and faster. These freebies must be enabled in your YAML if you wish to use them.
- The washpan trap decreases your katamari's size by 10%. The spider trap decreases your roll speed by 50% for 10 seconds.
The fog trap adds the fog from 'Lots of Yokai', which slowly dissipates over time.

## Known Issues
- Sometimes, when levels are unlocked, they can get stuck in the sky. This is just a visual bug, you can still play the
level by going to the location the level should be. 
This can also be fixed by reloading the scene (by selecting a stage in this era using the Select Scroll).
- The game cannot (re)connect to the server after launch. You must restart the game to (re)connect.

notes.text:
This updated mod is compatible with worlds generated using all older versions of the apworld. The apworld is not compatible with any older versions of the mod.
## Rolling LIVE Highlights
- Adds support for the new levels, cousins and collection from the new DLC Rolling LIVE Highlights
- You must own the DLC and enable it in your yaml to be able to access these
## Collectionsanity
- Objects in the Tutorial are no longer considered out of logic due to the Tutorial now being replayable
- In Individual mode, you can now choose how many unique objects grant checks so you don't have to spam your fellow players with stardust
- A new option was added to control the logic of collectionsanity in Cowbear Pasture. You can choose whether you want to exclude every object in Cowbear Pasture, exclude only the cows and bears (as defined by the king of course), or keep every object in the level in logic
## Other Changes
- Added Meteors (also known as Shooting Stars) as optional locations, granted by clearing As Large as Possible and As Fast as Possible levels quickly
- The "easyFinale" option was removed, and you are now guaranteed to always be able to clear That Hole... once you have enough planets
- You no longer have to use the cousin customizer before being able to interact with anything in the S.S. Prince
- The music player is now accessible from the start
- Now supports yamlless Universal Tracker

See the [README](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/blob/main/README.md) for more info and setup instructions.
